decisions.reason: Adjustable feature keeps its option value uncertain and worth maintaining at low cost.
Pegboard back differentiates it and preserves option value while uncertainty remains.
Standard quarter pallet faces commodity competition but still holds option value as a core display.
Eighth pallet serves a smaller segment and remains a low-cost option to keep open.
Wooden pallet diversifies beyond paper but has higher cost and unresolved demand, so the option is kept.
Media product display is niche but may still reveal value, so the option is maintained.
